entries.content: Noer is the last remaining city on the continent after the Black Mist event wiped out the city of Sybaris. It is home to The Burning Keg, Elise's Gynecologist Clinic, The Oriental Commerce, Central Noer Market, Tripartite Exchange, Catacombs, Sewers, and the Port of Noer. The majority of refugees cannot enter the city much less escape from the continent from the port at the high price of twenty gold coins.

The most famous tavern in Noer, open 24/7, all day and night. Also known to be the business office of The Mercenary's Guild. Can provide meals, accommodation, work, etc. Jobs found vary from mercenary work such as herb collection, clearing out undead in the cemetery, and killing Orkinds to helping out the proprietor by working as a waiter/waitress or as a dancer.

Elise's Gynecologist Clinic is the only place in Noer where you can receive medical help for a reasonable price. Its owner, Elise, is a very intelligent, sociopath who doesn't truly seem to care for anyone except for women, abominations, fishkinds, and orkinds.

Money is split up into small copper coins, large copper coins, and gold coins. One gold coin is worth ten large copper coins, one large copper coin is worth ten small copper coins, and one small copper coin is barely worth a loaf of bread. For the majority of people having several large copper coins makes them very well off. Only the richest people will ever have a single gold coin much less twenty.

Orkinds are a loose grouping of humanoid creatures such as goblins, hobgoblins, orcs, and orges. Goblins, known for their sly and nimble nature, make their homes deep within caves and abandoned shelters, concealed from the world's scrutiny. Hobgoblins, Orcs, and Ogres often lead bands of goblins on raiding parties to capture and impregnate women.

Fishkinds inhabit ancient Sea Witch Temples, carrying out activities that often involve aggression, kidnapping, and hostile encounters with both humans and their own kind. They are primarily found on Fishtopia Isle several miles away from the coast.

Within the ruins of Sybaris, Abominations have left a wake of ruin and despair. Those unfortunate humans who crossed paths with these nightmarish creatures were met with grim fates: some were transformed into zombies, while others were cruelly enslaved by the very flesh of Abominations, used to perpetuate their monstrous ranks. They range from the small Pot Worm and Moon Worm which parasitize victims urethras and rectums respectively to the larger zombies, tentacles, and Hive Hearts.
The undead are skeletons, not zombies, are found primarily residing in Noer Graveyard but there iss a slight chance of encountering them in other locations, such as the mountains.

Sybaris was the largest city on the continent until the Black Mist took over, killing the majority of its occupants while the remaining were either killed by orkinds or abominations but some managed to escape. It has been completely overrun by abominations and the few fortresses nearby are under constant attack.

A young necromancer victim of an attempted purge on the poor, who, after her parent's death, ended up growing up in a cemetery's underground catacomb, nearly losing all social capability from her time with them. She has survived by eating corpses and sacrificing her arm for the power of necromancy.

A naïve idealist with an impressive set of knockers who plots against the current rule to improve the lives of all refugees in Noer. In any other setting, Cecily Eaglemore would be hailed as a heroine of legendary renown. But in this wretched hive of an island? The blue-blooded adventurer is nothing more than a self-righteous fool, prone to being at the mercy of amoral degenerates that'll jump at the opportunity to use and abuse her wet high-born cunt.
Gray Rat or Vineet is Cecily's butler and companion. Do not let his polite nature fool you, if Cecily dies or is injured he will go on a rampage.
